about:
American HomePatient operates from Dover, Delaware, providing respiratory and home medical equipment services across the United States. The company has served patients for over 25 years, specializing in ventilator, oxygen, and sleep therapy equipment for home-based care.

The company supplies a range of durable medical equipment including ventilators, CPAP machines, oxygen systems, nebulizers, and enteral nutrition products. Through affiliated entities, it also offers pharmacy services dispensing FDA-approved pharmaceuticals, home INR testing, and wound care supplies. Services include disease management programs, clinical support, and caregiver education tailored to physician prescriptions.

American HomePatient serves patients with chronic respiratory conditions, obstructive sleep apnea, and mobility limitations in home settings. Its customer base includes ventilator-dependent individuals, those requiring long-term oxygen therapy, and tube-fed patients needing nutritional support. The company works with caregivers and healthcare providers to manage therapy programs for conditions such as COPD, sleep apnea, and acute or chronic wounds.

The company emphasizes clinical support and customized therapy programs over simple equipment delivery, aiming to improve health-related quality of life for homebound patients. Its affiliated pharmacy network and in-home testing services extend care beyond standard DME provision, with programs designed to give patients as much normalcy as possible in their daily lives.
